content:
In June this year, Anthropic first released its Mythos-class AI model Fable 5, applicable to Claude. Three months later, Anthropic enhanced Claude again with an all-new Fable 5.1 model upgrade.

Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 debuted simultaneously today

In Anthropic's positioning, Fable is Claude's most powerful model. Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus are the small, medium, and large tier models beneath Fable.

Anthropic stated: "Claude Fable 5.1 has set new standards in programming, knowledge work, and long-running problem-solving tasks." The company also said the new model's performance level is even more outstanding compared to Fable 5.

Anthropic also pointed out that when Fable 5.1 is set to low or medium compute, "it can achieve results similar to or even better than Fable 5 at a significantly reduced cost."

More news from Anthropic is as follows:

In addition to Fable 5.1, Anthropic also simultaneously released Mythos 5.1 for users with Mythos access.

Anthropic explained: "Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 are actually the same model, just with different levels of safety guardrails. Fable 5.1 is fully open, while Mythos 5.1 is only available through our trusted access programme; its safety guardrails are specifically designed for work in the cybersecurity and life sciences fields."

Regarding pricing, Anthropic said it has "lowered the price of Fable 5.1 cache reads (where the model reuses previously processed context), as long as usage is billed by tokens, such as through our API." The company pointed out that this move "significantly reduces the overall cost of running the model." Apart from this, pricing remains unchanged from Fable 5.
